newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Banco Itau takes over insurer.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Banco Itau takes over insurer.

text.p: Brazil's Itausa group said it has decided to transfer control of its insurance unit Itau Seguros to bank Banco Itau under a restructuring of the group's holdings.
"Hoping to achieve new synergies and strengthen its performance in that market, Itausa decided to transfer the control of Itau Seguros to Banco Itau," the group said in a statement.
Banco Itau will assume control of 91.6 percent of the insurance unit and increase Itau Seguros' capital by 200 million reais.
Further details were to be given at a news conference later this afternoon.
Itau is Brazil's second largest private bank and Itausa is one of the country's largest private conglomerates.
